# Vishal Solanki - Software Engineer

> Software Engineer / Full Stack Engineer with 3.5+ years of professional experience building production web applications. Based in Noida, India.

## Professional Profile

Vishal works across frontend and backend development. His primary stack includes React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Express.js, MySQL, MongoDB, AWS, and Docker.

His engineering experience includes full-stack application development, REST APIs, authentication and authorization, secure server-side workflows, performance and bundle optimization, caching, Core Web Vitals, SEO, accessibility, AWS deployments, Docker, CI/CD, GA4, and Google Tag Manager.

## Availability

Open to full-time, contract, and freelance Software Engineering / Full Stack opportunities.

### Software Engineer, Ambak

January 2026 to present. Builds production features for ambak.com using Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, MySQL, AWS, and Docker. Work includes customer onboarding, home-loan discovery, CIBIL workflows, financial-product experiences, secure server-side workflows, caching, performance optimization, SEO, analytics, and design-system implementation.
